<style>
	@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Source+Serif+4:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500&display=swap');

:root {
	--user-opacity-paper: 95%; /* change this for opacity */
	--user-base: 17px; 	/* change this for font size */
	--user-unit: clamp(0px, calc(var(--user-base)/17), 3px);
	--user-document-max-width:
	clamp(200px, calc(var(--user-base) * 40.00), 600px);
/* SPACING SCALE */
	--user-space-d015: clamp(0px, calc(var(--user-unit) / 1.5), 2.25px);
	--user-space-005: clamp(0.25px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 0.5), 0.75px);
	--user-space-007: clamp(0.25px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 0.75), 1.2px);
	--user-space-015: clamp(0.75px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 1.5), 2.25px);
	--user-space-01: clamp(0.5px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 1), 1.5px);
	--user-space-02: clamp(1px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 2), 3px);
	--user-space-03: clamp(1.75px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 3), 4.5px);
	--user-space-04: clamp(2px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 4), 6px);
	--user-space-05: clamp(2.5px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 5), 7.5px);
	--user-space-06: clamp(3px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 6), 12px);
	--user-space-07: clamp(3.5px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 7), 10.5px);
	--user-space-08: clamp(4px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 8), 12px);
	--user-space-09: clamp(4.5px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 9), 18px);
	--user-space-10: clamp(5px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 10), 15px);
	--user-space-12: clamp(6px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 12), 18px);
	--user-space-14: clamp(7px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 14), 21px);
	--user-space-16: clamp(8px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 16), 24px);
	--user-space-18: clamp(9px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 18), 27px);
	--user-space-20: clamp(10px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 20), 30px);
	--user-space-22: clamp(11px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 22), 33px);
	--user-space-24: clamp(12px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 24), 36px);
	--user-space-26: clamp(13px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 26), 39px);
	--user-space-28: clamp(14px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 28), 42px);
	--user-space-30: clamp(15px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 30), 45px);
	--user-space-32: clamp(16px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 32), 48px);
	--user-space-34: clamp(17px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 34), 51px);
	--user-space-36: clamp(18px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 36), 54px);
	--user-space-44: clamp(22px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 44), 66px);
	--user-space-48: clamp(24px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 48), 72px);
	--user-space-52: clamp(26px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 52), 78px);
	--user-space-56: clamp(28px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 56), 84px);
	--user-space-60: clamp(30px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 60), 90px);
	--user-space-64: clamp(32px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 64), 96px);
	--user-space-70: clamp(35px, calc(var(--user-unit) * 70), 105px);
/* GEOMETRY */
	--user-document-padding-outer:
	var(--user-space-05);
	--user-document-padding-inner:
	0 var(--user-space-52) 0;
	--user-document-padding-header:
	var(--user-space-48) 
	var(--user-space-52)
	var(--user-space-24);
	--user-document-padding-footer:
	var(--user-space-18)
	var(--user-space-64)
	var(--user-space-36);
/* TYPOGRAPHY */
	--user-font-family-body:
	'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif;
	--user-font-family-display:
	'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
	--user-font-family-mono:
	'Courier New', monospace;
	--user-font-family-script:
	'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif;

	--user-font-size-body:
	var(--user-base);
	--user-font-size-code:
	var(--user-space-16);
	--user-font-size-title:
	var(--user-space-26);
	--user-font-size-field-label:
	var(--user-space-08);
	--user-font-size-field-value:
	var(--user-space-10);
	--user-font-size-dropdown-item:
	var(--user-space-10);
	--user-font-size-subtitle:
	var(--user-space-09);
	--user-font-size-footer-text:
	var(--user-space-08);
	--user-font-size-page-number:
	var(--user-space-14);
	--user-font-size-code:
	var(--user-space-16);
	--user-font-size-footnote-number:
	var(--user-space-08);
	
	--user-font-weight-light: 300;
	--user-font-weight-body: 400;
	--user-font-weight-bold: 600;
	
	--user-line-height-body:
	var(--user-space-26);
	--user-line-height-title:
	var(--user-space-14);
	--user-line-height-footer:
	var(--user-space-14);
	
	--user-letter-spacing-meta:
	var(--user-space-02);
	--user-letter-spacing-label:
	var(--user-space-02);
	--user-letter-spacing-value:
	var(--user-space-01);
	--user-letter-spacing-body:
	var(--user-space-005);
	--user-letter-spacing-title:
	calc(var(--user-unit) * -0.5);
/* BORDERS */
	--user-border-width-thin:
	var(--user-space-01);
	--user-border-width-medium:
	var(--user-space-02);
	--user-border-radius-document-sheet:
	var(--user-space-02);
	--user-border-radius-tape:
	var(--user-space-01);
	--user-border-radius-dropdown:
	var(--user-space-02);
	--user-border-radius-strikethrough:
	var(--user-space-02);
/* SHADOWS */
	--user-shadow-document-sheet:
	0 var(--user-space-02)
	var(--user-space-08)
	rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
	--user-shadow-dropdown:
	0 var(--user-space-02)
	var(--user-space-04)
	rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
	--user-text-shadow:
	0 0	var(--user-space-005)
	var(--user-color-text-body);
/* OPACITY */
	--user-opacity-mark: 0.50;
	--user-opacity-accent-01: 1.00;
	--user-opacity-accent-02: 1.00;
	--user-opacity-accent-03: 1.00;
/* TRANSFORMS */
	--user-translate-x-center: -50%;
	--user-translate-y-chevron:
	clamp(-4px, calc(var(--user-unit) * -2), -2px);
	--user-translate-y-strikethrough: -50%;
/* TRANSITIONS */
	--user-transition-speed-fast: 0.35s ease;
	--user-transition-speed-dropdown: 0.25s ease;
/* RULE LINES */
	--user-rule-text-spacing:
	var(--user-space-22);
	--user-rule-line-spacing:
	calc(var(--user-line-height-body) - var(--user-unit));
	--user-rule-line-height:
	var(--user-line-height-body);
	--user-rule-margin-line-offset:
	clamp(-48px, calc(var(--user-line-height-body) * -1), -2px);
/* DROPDOWN ANIMATION */
	--user-dropdown-vertical-offset:
	var(--user-space-06);
	--user-dropdown-unfurl-duration: 0.30s;
	--user-dropdown-unfurl-easing:
	cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.75, 0.45, 1);
	--user-dropdown-item-stagger-delay: 0.075s;

/* THEME-01 */
	--user-color-paper-base: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1);
	--user-color-bg: rgba(185, 185, 180, 1);
	--user-color-text-body: rgba(20, 20, 20, 1);
	--user-color-text-faded: rgba(100, 100, 100, 1);
	--user-color-rule-line: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.1);
	--user-color-rule-accent: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.15);
	--user-color-paper-edge: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.15);
	--user-color-paper-shadow: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1);
	--user-color-text-accent-01: rgba(60, 60, 65, 1);
	--user-color-text-accent-02: rgba(85, 85, 90, 1);
	--user-color-text-accent-03: rgba(110, 110, 115, 1);
	--user-color-tape-fill-02: rgba(200, 200, 195, 0.35);
	}
/* THEME-01 */
	body.theme-02 {
	--user-color-paper-base: rgba(200, 200, 195, 1);
	--user-color-bg: rgba(155, 155, 150, 1);
	--user-color-text-body: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1);
	--user-color-text-faded: rgba(70, 70, 70, 1);
	--user-color-rule-line: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
	--user-color-rule-accent: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
	--user-color-paper-edge: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
	--user-color-paper-shadow: rgba(215, 215, 215, 1);
	--user-color-text-accent-01: rgba(30, 30, 35, 1);
	--user-color-text-accent-02: rgba(55, 55, 60, 1);
	--user-color-text-accent-03: rgba(80, 80, 85, 1);
	--user-color-tape-fill-02: rgba(170, 170, 165, 0.35);
	}
/* THEME-03 */
	body.theme-03 {
	--user-color-paper-base: rgba(25, 25, 30, 1);
	--user-color-bg: rgba(15, 15, 20, 1);
	--user-color-text-body: rgba(225, 225, 230, 1);
	--user-color-text-faded: rgba(130, 130, 135, 1);
	--user-color-rule-line: rgba(225, 225, 230, 0.1);
	--user-color-rule-accent: rgba(225, 225, 230, 0.15);
	--user-color-paper-edge: rgba(225, 225, 230, 0.15);
	--user-color-paper-shadow: rgba(10, 10, 15, 1);
	--user-color-text-accent-01: rgba(180, 180, 185, 1);
	--user-color-text-accent-02: rgba(155, 155, 160, 1);
	--user-color-text-accent-03: rgba(130, 130, 135, 1);
	--user-color-tape-fill-02: rgba(80, 80, 85, 0.35);
	}
/* THEME-04 */
	body.theme-04 {
	--user-color-paper-base: rgba(225, 215, 190, 1);
	--user-color-bg: rgba(185, 165, 130, 1);
	--user-color-text-body: rgba(50, 35, 20, 1);
	--user-color-text-faded: rgba(130, 100, 65, 1);
	--user-color-rule-line: rgba(50, 35, 20, 0.1);
	--user-color-rule-accent: rgba(50, 35, 20, 0.15);
	--user-color-paper-edge: rgba(50, 35, 20, 0.15);
	--user-color-paper-shadow: rgba(230, 220, 195, 1);
	--user-color-text-accent-01: rgba(105, 85, 65, 1);
	--user-color-text-accent-02: rgba(130, 110, 90, 1);
	--user-color-text-accent-03: rgba(155, 135, 115, 1);
	--user-color-tape-fill-02: rgba(200, 180, 150, 0.35);
	}
/* THEME-05
	body.theme-05 {
Copy & Paste everything inside body.theme-04 here 
	and change the values in it to your liking.
	Recommendation: keep the alpha values similar/unchanged)
	} */

/* DOCUMENT HEADER */
	.user-document-header {
	position: relative;
	z-index: 10;
	padding: var(--user-document-padding-header);
	border-bottom:
	var(--user-border-width-thin)
	solid var(--user-color-paper-edge);
	overflow: visible;
	}
	.user-header-date {
	font-family: var(--user-font-family-display);
	font-size: var(--user-font-size-subtitle);
	font-weight: var(--user-font-weight-body);
	letter-spacing: var(--user-letter-spacing-meta);
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--user-color-text-faded);
	margin-bottom: var(--user-space-28);
	}
	.user-header-title-text {
	font-family: var(--user-font-family-body);
	font-size: var(--user-font-size-title);
	font-weight: var(--user-font-weight-light);
	color: var(--user-color-text-body);
	letter-spacing: var(--user-letter-spacing-title);
	line-height: var(--user-line-height-title);
	border-bottom:
	var(--user-border-width-medium)
	solid var(--user-color-text-body);
	padding-bottom: var(--user-space-12);
	margin-bottom: var(--user-space-09);
	}
	.user-header-subtitle-text {
	font-family: var(--user-font-family-display);
	font-size: var(--user-font-size-subtitle);
	font-weight: var(--user-font-weight-body);
	letter-spacing: var(--user-letter-spacing-meta);
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--user-color-text-faded);
	}
/* HEADER CONTROLS ROW */
	.user-header-controls-row {
	display: flex;
	gap: var(--user-space-32);
	align-items: flex-end;
	margin-top: var(--user-space-20);
	overflow: visible;
	}
	.user-header-control-field {
	position: relative;
	flex: 1;
	overflow: visible;
	}
/* FIELD LABELS */
	.user-field-label {
	font-family: var(--user-font-family-display);
	font-size: var(--user-font-size-field-label);
	font-weight: 500;
	letter-spacing: var(--user-letter-spacing-label);
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--user-color-text-faded);
	margin-bottom: var(--user-space-05);
	}
/* CUSTOM DROPDOWN SELECT */
	.user-dropdown-select {
	position: relative;
	cursor: pointer;
	
	outline: none;
	overflow: visible;
	}
	.user-dropdown-select-face {
	display: flex;	align-items: center;
	justify-content: space-between;
	padding: var(--user-space-04) 0px;
	border-bottom:
	var(--user-border-width-thin)
	solid var(--user-color-paper-edge);
	transition: border-color var(--user-transition-speed-fast);
	}
	.user-dropdown-select:hover
	.user-dropdown-select-face,
	.user-dropdown-select.is-open
	.user-dropdown-select-face {
	border-bottom-color: var(--user-color-text-body);
	}
	.user-dropdown-select-current-value {
	font-family: var(--user-font-family-display);
	font-size: var(--user-font-size-field-value);
	font-weight: var(--user-font-weight-body);
	color: var(--user-color-text-body);
	letter-spacing: var(--user-letter-spacing-value);
	}
	.user-dropdown-select-chevron {
	width: var(--user-space-05);
	height: var(--user-space-05);
	border-right:
	var(--user-border-width-thin)
	solid var(--user-color-text-faded);
	border-bottom:
	var(--user-border-width-thin)
	solid var(--user-color-text-faded);
	transform:
	rotate(45deg)
	translateY(var(--user-translate-y-chevron));
	transition:
	transform
	var(--user-transition-speed-dropdown);
	flex-shrink: 0;
	}
	.user-dropdown-select.is-open
	.user-dropdown-select-chevron {
	transform:
	rotate(225deg)
	translateY(var(--user-translate-y-chevron));
	}
	.user-dropdown-options-list {
	display: none;
	position: absolute;
	top:
	calc(100% +
	var(--user-dropdown-vertical-offset));
	left: 0px;
	right: 0px;
	z-index: 9999;
	list-style: none;
	background: var(--user-color-paper-base);
	border:
	var(--user-border-width-thin)
	solid var(--user-color-paper-edge);
	border-radius: var(--user-border-radius-dropdown);
	box-shadow: var(--user-shadow-dropdown);
	}
	.user-dropdown-select.is-open
	.user-dropdown-options-list {
	display: block;
	animation:
	dropdown-unfurl var(--user-dropdown-unfurl-duration)
	var(--user-dropdown-unfurl-easing) both;
	}
	@keyframes dropdown-unfurl {
	from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px); }
	to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
	}
	.user-dropdown-option-item {
	font-family: var(--user-font-family-display);
	font-size: var(--user-font-size-dropdown-item);
	font-weight: var(--user-font-weight-body);
	color: var(--user-color-text-faded);
	padding:
	var(--user-space-09)
	var(--user-space-12);
	cursor: pointer;
	letter-spacing: var(--user-letter-spacing-value);
	transition:
	background var(--user-transition-speed-dropdown),
	color var(--user-transition-speed-dropdown);
	}
	.user-dropdown-option-item +
	.user-dropdown-option-item {
	border-top:
	var(--user-border-width-thin)
	solid var(--user-color-rule-line);
	}
	.user-dropdown-option-item:hover {
	background: var(--user-color-rule-line);
	color: var(--user-color-text-body);
	}
	.user-dropdown-option-item.is-selected {
	color: var(--user-color-text-body);
	font-weight: var(--user-font-weight-bold);
	}
/* DOCUMENT FOOTER */
	.user-document-footer {
	padding: var(--user-document-padding-footer);
	border-top:
	var(--user-border-width-thin)
	solid var(--user-color-paper-edge);
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
	align-items: end;
	gap: var(--user-space-12);
	}
	.user-footer-column {
	font-family: var(--user-font-family-display);
	font-size: var(--user-font-size-footer-text);
	font-weight: var(--user-font-weight-body);
	letter-spacing: var(--user-letter-spacing-meta);
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--user-color-text-faded);
	line-height: var(--user-line-height-footer);
	}
	.user-footer-column.align-center {
	text-align: center; }
	.user-footer-column.align-right {
	text-align: right; }
	.user-footer-column em {
	font-style: normal;
	font-family: var(--user-font-family-body);
	font-size: var(--user-font-size-footer-text);
	font-weight: var(--user-font-weight-body);
	color: var(--user-color-text-body);
	letter-spacing: 0px;
	display: block;
	text-transform: none;
	margin-bottom: var(--user-space-04);
	}
	.user-footer-page-number {
	font-family: var(--user-font-family-body);
	font-size: var(--user-font-size-page-number);
	font-weight: var(--user-font-weight-light);
	color: var(--user-color-text-body);
	display: block;
	margin-bottom: var(--user-space-02);
	}
	.user-footer-underline-row {
	border-top:
	var(--user-border-width-thin)
	solid var(--user-color-rule-accent);
	margin-top: var(--user-space-05);
	padding-top: var(--user-space-05);
	}
/* = DOCUMENT SHEET */
	.user-document-sheet {
	position: relative;
	background: var(--user-color-paper-base);
	opacity: var(--user-opacity-paper);
	box-shadow: var(--user-shadow-document-sheet);
	border:
	var(--user-border-width-thin)
	solid var(--user-color-paper-edge);
	border-radius:
	var(--user-border-radius-document-sheet);
	overflow: visible;
	}
/* = DOCUMENT BODY */
	.user-document-body {
	position: relative;
	z-index: 5;
	padding: var(--user-document-padding-inner);
	}
	.user-document-body-ruled-lines {
	position: relative;
	}
	.user-document-body-ruled-lines::before {
	content: '';
	position: absolute;
	left: var(--user-rule-margin-line-offset);
	top: 0; bottom: 0;
	width: var(--user-border-width-thin);
	background: var(--user-color-rule-accent);
	}
/* = LETTER TEXT CONTENT */
	.user-letter-text-content strong,
	.user-letter-text-content em,
	.user-letter-text-content u,
	.user-letter-text-content mark,
	.user-letter-text-content del,
	.user-letter-text-content s,
	.user-letter-text-content sub,
	.user-letter-text-content sup,
	.user-letter-text-content q,
	.user-letter-text-content h1,
	.user-letter-text-content h2,
	.user-letter-text-content h3,
	.user-letter-text-content h4,
	.user-letter-text-content h5,
	.user-letter-text-content h6 {
	line-height: var(--user-line-height-body) !important;
	vertical-align: baseline !important;
	}
.user-letter-text-content *[style] strong,
.user-letter-text-content *[style] em,
.user-letter-text-content *[style] u,
.user-letter-text-content *[style] mark,
.user-letter-text-content *[style] del,
.user-letter-text-content *[style] s,
.user-letter-text-content *[style] sub,
.user-letter-text-content *[style] sup,
.user-letter-text-content *[style] q,
.user-letter-text-content *[style] h1,
.user-letter-text-content *[style] h2,
.user-letter-text-content *[style] h3,
.user-letter-text-content *[style] h4,
.user-letter-text-content *[style] h5,
.user-letter-text-content *[style] h6 {
color: inherit;
}

		
	/* Base Text ✔️*/
		.user-letter-text-content {
		margin-top: 0 !important;
		margin-bottom: 0 !important;
		font-family: var(--user-font-family-body) !important;
		font-size: var(--user-font-size-body) !important;
		font-weight: var(--user-font-weight-body) !important;
		line-height:
		var(--user-line-height-body);
		color: var(--user-color-text-body);
		letter-spacing:
		var(--user-letter-spacing-body) !important;
		white-space: pre-wrap;
		word-wrap: break-word;
		position: relative;
		z-index: 2;
		text-align: justify;
		hyphens: auto;
		text-shadow: var(--user-text-shadow);
		}
		.user-letter-text-content.align-justified {
		text-align: justify; hyphens: auto; }
		.user-letter-text-content.align-left {
		text-align: left; hyphens: auto; }
		.user-letter-text-content.align-right {
		text-align: right; hyphens: auto; }
	/* Paragraph */
		.user-letter-text-content p {
		margin-bottom:
		var(--user-line-height-body);
		}
	/* Quote ✔️*/
		.user-letter-text-content q {
font-family: var(--user-font-family-body) !important;
		font-size: var(--user-font-size-body) !important;
		font-weight: var(--user-font-weight-body) !important;
		color: var(--user-color-text-accent-01);
		border-bottom: var(--user-border-width-thin)
		solid var(--user-color-text-accent-02);
		quotes: "\201C" "\201D" !important;
		}
		.user-letter-text-content q::before,
		.user-letter-text-content q::after {

/* 01. DATE */
	var dateElement = document.getElementById('doc-date');
	if (dateElement) {
	var now = new Date();
	var month = now.toLocaleString('en-US', { month: 'long' });
	var day = now.getDate();
	var year = now.getFullYear();
	dateElement.textContent = month + ' ' + day + ', ' + year;
	}

	var themeOptions = [
	{ bodyClass: '', label: 'White' },
	{ bodyClass: 'theme-02', label: 'Grey' },
	{ bodyClass: 'theme-03', label: 'Black' },

	var textAlignmentOptions = [
	{ textClass: 'align-justified', label: 'Justify' },
	{ textClass: 'align-left', label: 'Left' },
	{ textClass: 'align-right', label: 'Right' },
	];
/* 04. PERSISTED STATE */
	function safeGet(key, fallback) {
	try {
	var value = typeof tavo !== 'undefined' ? tavo.get(key) : localStorage.getItem(key);
	return (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '') ? String(value) : fallback;
	} catch (_) { return fallback; }
	}
	
	function safeSave(key, value) {
	try { 
	if (typeof tavo !== 'undefined') { tavo.set(key, value); } 
	else { localStorage.setItem(key, value); }
	} catch (_) {}
	}	
	var activeThemeIndex = parseInt(safeGet('usertext_SimplePaper', '0'), 10);
	var activeAlignmentIndex = parseInt(safeGet('usertext_AlignMode', '0'), 10);
	
	if (isNaN(activeThemeIndex) || activeThemeIndex < 0 || activeThemeIndex >= themeOptions.length) activeThemeIndex = 0;
	if (isNaN(activeAlignmentIndex) || activeAlignmentIndex < 0 || activeAlignmentIndex >= textAlignmentOptions.length) activeAlignmentIndex = 0;
/* 05. APPLY THEME */
	function applyTheme(index) {
	document.body.classList.remove(
	'theme-02', 'theme-03', 'theme-04'/*, 'theme-05'*/);
	if (themeOptions[index].bodyClass) {
	document.body.classList.add(	themeOptions[index].bodyClass);
	}}
/* 06. APPLY TEXT ALIGNMENT */
	function applyTextAlignment(index) {
	var textElement = document.getElementById('letter-text-content');
	if (!textElement) return;
	textElement.classList.remove('align-justified', 'align-left', 'align-right');
	textElement.classList.add(textAlignmentOptions[index].textClass);
	}
/* 07. SYNC DROPDOWN DISPLAY */
	function syncDropdownDisplay(dropdownId, valueElementId, optionsList, activeIndex) {
	var valueElement = document.getElementById(valueElementId);
	if (valueElement) valueElement.textContent = optionsList[activeIndex].label;
	
	var dropdownElement = document.getElementById(dropdownId);
	if (!dropdownElement) return;
	var allOptionItems = dropdownElement.querySelectorAll('.user-dropdown-option-item');
	for (var i = 0; i < allOptionItems.length; i++) {
	allOptionItems[i].classList.toggle('is-selected', i === activeIndex);
	}}

	function closeAllDropdowns() {
	var openDropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.user-dropdown-select.is-open');

	openDropdowns[i].classList.remove('is-open');
	openDropdowns[i].setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
	}}

	function initDropdown(dropdownId, onSelectCallback) {
	var dropdownElement = document.getElementById(dropdownId);
	if (!dropdownElement) return;
	
	dropdownElement.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
	var isAlreadyOpen = dropdownElement.classList.contains('is-open');
	closeAllDropdowns();	if (!isAlreadyOpen) {
	dropdownElement.classList.add('is-open');
	dropdownElement.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
	}
	event.stopPropagation();
	});
	
	dropdownElement.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
	var optionItems = dropdownElement.querySelectorAll('.user-dropdown-option-item');
	var currentIndex = -1;
	for (var i = 0; i < optionItems.length; i++) {
	if (optionItems[i].classList.contains('is-selected')) { currentIndex = i; break; }
	}
	
	if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
	event.preventDefault();	dropdownElement.classList.toggle('is-open');
	dropdownElement.setAttribute('aria-expanded', dropdownElement.classList.contains('is-open').toString());
	} else if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
	event.preventDefault();
	onSelectCallback((currentIndex + 1) % optionItems.length);
	} else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
	event.preventDefault();
	onSelectCallback((currentIndex - 1 + optionItems.length) % optionItems.length);
	} else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
	dropdownElement.classList.remove('is-open');
	dropdownElement.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
	}
	});
	
	var optionItems = dropdownElement.querySelectorAll('.user-dropdown-option-item');
	for (var i = 0; i < optionItems.length; i++) {

	}}
	
	document.addEventListener('click', closeAllDropdowns);
/* 10. WIRE UP DROPDOWNS */
	initDropdown('dropdown-theme', function (index) {
	activeThemeIndex = index;
	applyTheme(index);
	syncDropdownDisplay('dropdown-theme', 'dropdown-theme-value', themeOptions, index);
	safeSave('usertext_SimplePaper', String(index));	});
	
	initDropdown('dropdown-text-alignment', function (index) {
	activeAlignmentIndex = index;
	applyTextAlignment(index);
	syncDropdownDisplay('dropdown-text-alignment', 'dropdown-text-alignment-value', textAlignmentOptions, index);
	safeSave('usertext_AlignMode', String(index));
	if (window.__snapLetterGrid) window.__snapLetterGrid();
	});
/* 11. APPLY INITIAL STATE */
	applyTheme(activeThemeIndex);
	applyTextAlignment(activeAlignmentIndex);
	syncDropdownDisplay(
	'dropdown-theme',
	'dropdown-theme-value',
	themeOptions, activeThemeIndex);
	syncDropdownDisplay(
	'dropdown-text-alignment',
	'dropdown-text-alignment-value',
	textAlignmentOptions, activeAlignmentIndex);
	})();
/* 12. STRUCTURAL MARKERS */
	var markersProcessed = false;

	function processMarkers(container) {
	if (!container || markersProcessed) return;
	markersProcessed = true;

	var html = container.innerHTML;
	var MARKER_RE = /\$(Title|NPC|Time|Message)\s*\[([\s\S]*?)\]/g;

	var newHtml = html.replace(MARKER_RE, function (match, type, value) {
	type = type.toLowerCase();
	value = value.trim();

	if (type === 'message') {
	var incomingIdx = value.indexOf('<');
	var ltLen = 4;
	var isIncoming = incomingIdx >= 0 && incomingIdx < 30;
	if (!isIncoming) {
	var rawLt = value.match(/<(?![a-zA-Z\/!])/);
	if (rawLt) { incomingIdx = rawLt.index; ltLen = 1; isIncoming = incomingIdx < 30; }
	}
	if (!isIncoming) {
	incomingIdx = value.indexOf(':');
	ltLen = 1;
	isIncoming = incomingIdx >= 0 && incomingIdx < 20;
	}
	var outgoingIdx = value.indexOf('>');
	var gtLen = 4;
	var isOutgoing = outgoingIdx >= 0 && outgoingIdx < 30;
	if (!isOutgoing) {
	var rawGt = value.match(/>(?![a-zA-Z\/!])/);
	if (rawGt) { outgoingIdx = rawGt.index; gtLen = 1; isOutgoing = outgoingIdx < 30; }
	}

	var directionClass = isIncoming ? 'incoming' : 'outgoing';
	var bubbleContent = '';
	if (isIncoming) {
	var sender = value.slice(0, incomingIdx).trim();
	var msg = value.slice(incomingIdx + ltLen).trim();
	bubbleContent =
	'<span class="user-marker-message-sender">' + sender + '</span>' +
	'<span class="user-marker-message-text">' + msg + '</span>';
	} else if (isOutgoing) {
	var sender = value.slice(0, outgoingIdx).trim();
	var msg = value.slice(outgoingIdx + gtLen).trim();
	bubbleContent =
	'<span class="user-marker-message-sender">' + sender + '</span>' +
	'<span class="user-marker-message-text">' + msg + '</span>';
	} else {
	bubbleContent = '<span class="user-marker-message-text">' + value + '</span>';
	}
	return '<div class="user-marker-message-wrap ' + directionClass + '" data-message-wrap="true">' +
	'<div class="user-marker-message-bubble">' + bubbleContent + '</div></div>';
	} else {
	return '<span class="user-marker-' + type + '">' + value + '</span>';
	}
	});

	/* FIX: write newHtml cleanly — never reassign from old innerHTML */
	if (newHtml !== html) {
	newHtml = newHtml.replace(
	/<\/div>\s*(?:<br\s*\/?>\s*)*<div class="user-marker-message-wrap/gi,
	'</div><div class="user-marker-message-wrap'
	);
	container.innerHTML = newHtml;
	}

	/* Snap message bubbles to line grid */
	setTimeout(function () {
	var lineHeight = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(container).lineHeight);
	var wraps = container.querySelectorAll('[data-message-wrap]');
	wraps.forEach(function (wrap) {
	var bubble = wrap.querySelector('.user-marker-message-bubble');
	if (bubble && lineHeight) {
	var linesNeeded = Math.ceil(bubble.offsetHeight / lineHeight);
	wrap.style.height = (linesNeeded * lineHeight) + 'px';
	}
	});
	}, 100);
	}
/* 13. DETAILS SNAP TO GRID */
	function snapDetailsToGrid(container) {
	if (!container) return;
	var lineHeight = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(container).lineHeight);
	if (!lineHeight) return;
	container.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(function (details) {
	function snap() {
	details.style.height = 'auto';
	requestAnimationFrame(function () {
	if (!details.open) {
	var summary = details.querySelector('summary');
	if (summary) details.style.height = summary.offsetHeight + 'px';
	return;
	}
	var lines = Math.ceil(details.scrollHeight / lineHeight);
	details.style.height = (lines * lineHeight) + 'px';
	});
	}
	snap();
	details.addEventListener('toggle', snap);
	});
	}
/* 14. DRAW RULE LINES */
	var ruleOverlay = null;

	function getContainerLines(root) {
	var range = document.createRange();
	var EXCLUDE = 'details, summary, pre, code, [data-message-wrap], [data-rule-overlay]';
	var walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
	acceptNode: function (node) {
	if (node.parentElement && node.parentElement.closest(EXCLUDE))
	return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
	return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
	}
	});
	var lineMap = [];
	var TOLERANCE = 2;
	var node;
	while ((node = walker.nextNode())) {
	if (!node.textContent || !node.textContent.replace(/[\s\n\r]+/g, '')) continue;
	range.selectNodeContents(node);
	var rects = range.getClientRects();
	for (var i = 0; i < rects.length; i++) {
	var r = rects[i];
	if (r.height === 0) continue;
	var merged = false;
	for (var j = 0; j < lineMap.length; j++) {
	if (Math.abs(lineMap[j].top - r.top) <= TOLERANCE) {
	lineMap[j].bottom = Math.max(lineMap[j].bottom, r.bottom);
	merged = true; break;
	}
	}
	if (!merged) lineMap.push({ top: r.top, bottom: r.bottom });
	}
	}
	lineMap.sort(function (a, b) { return a.top - b.top; });
	return lineMap;
	}

	function drawRuleLines(container) {
	if (!container) return;
	var containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
	var lines = getContainerLines(container);
	if (ruleOverlay) ruleOverlay.remove();
	ruleOverlay = document.createElement('div');
	ruleOverlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
	ruleOverlay.setAttribute('data-rule-overlay', 'true');
	ruleOverlay.style.cssText =
	'position:absolute;left:0;top:0;right:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;height:' +
	container.clientHeight + 'px';
	var ruleColor = getComputedStyle(container)
	.getPropertyValue('--user-color-rule-line').trim() || 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';
	var ruleWidth = getComputedStyle(container)
	.getPropertyValue('--user-border-width-thin').trim() || '1px';
	var containerHeight = container.clientHeight;
	lines.forEach(function (line) {
	var top = line.bottom - containerRect.top + container.scrollTop;
	if (top < 0 || top > containerHeight) return;
	var lineEl = document.createElement('div');
	lineEl.style.cssText =
	'position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:' + top + 'px;height:' +
	ruleWidth + ';background:' + ruleColor;
	ruleOverlay.appendChild(lineEl);
	});
	container.insertBefore(ruleOverlay, container.firstChild);
	}

	function scheduleGridSnap(container) {
	requestAnimationFrame(function () {
	requestAnimationFrame(function () {
	drawRuleLines(container);
	});
	});
	}
/* 15. INIT */
	setTimeout(function () {
	var container = document.getElementById('letter-text-content');
	if (!container) return;

	/* process markers FIRST, before anything reads the DOM */
	processMarkers(container);
	snapDetailsToGrid(container);

	/* draw rule lines after fonts load */
	if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
	document.fonts.ready.then(function () { scheduleGridSnap(container); });
	} else {
	scheduleGridSnap(container);
	}

	/* re-draw on resize */
	var resizeTimer;
	new ResizeObserver(function () {
	clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
	resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () { scheduleGridSnap(container); }, 100);
	}).observe(container);

	/* expose for alignment dropdown callback */
	window.__snapLetterGrid = function () { scheduleGridSnap(container); };
	}, 0);
</script>
